lineage.core_design: flood-season map custody and layered survey plates

chapters.title: Blue-alert badge rule
chapters.body: During a blue-flood alert, survey plates may be released only by the registered wearer of the cobalt tide badge.

chapters.title: Blue-alert badge inspection
chapters.body: The blue-alert inspection log records Doran Pike as the registered wearer of the cobalt tide badge.

chapters.title: Final-glaze counting rule
chapters.body: The current pane count of the north survey window is the number of panes visible in its final-glaze preservation photograph.

chapters.title: Final-glaze photograph
chapters.body: The final-glaze preservation photograph of the north survey window shows fifteen separately framed mica panes.

chapters.title: Latitude stencil
chapters.body: The tide table stencil marks the equinox latitude with a narrow silver line.

chapters.title: Archive bell
chapters.body: Raster Hall closes its map drawers after two low bells and one high bell.

chapters.title: Initialed margin note
chapters.body: A margin note is initialed M. A.; both Miri Ansel and Mara Aven were present, and no witness identifies the writer.

chapters.title: Unlogged courier seal
chapters.body: The courier seal is intact, but the dispatch book leaves its destination field blank.
